name: PicClick eBay listing aggregator (asking prices)
notes: Third-party aggregator over eBay listings, reachable when ebay.com itself returns 403. AUDIT FLAG - READ BEFORE USING: (1) these are ASK prices on live Buy-It-Now listings, NOT sold/closed prices; (2) PicClick's Condition=USED,Used and CompletedSold=true query params are INERT - byte-identical page returned with and without them, verified 2026-10-03 - so condition and sold-status CANNOT be read off this source; (3) the result set mixes bare cards with heatsinks, backplanes, adapters, bare baseboards, broken/parts units, complete systems and laptops under the same query. All records built from it state asking-basis explicitly and were filtered by title.
